title: String Permutations
statement_md:
Given a string `s`, return all unique permutations of the characters in `s` sorted in lexicographical order.

If `s` is empty, return `['']`.
hints: Use recursion or backtracking, selecting each unused character at the current position.
Handle duplicate characters by sorting the characters first or using a set to store unique permutations.
Return the sorted list of distinct permutation strings.
